title: GoOrganicAfrica 44-country calculator readiness — Zimbabwe follow-up 61

administrative_geography.verified_by: Government of Zimbabwe Ministry of Foreign Affairs; ZIMSTAT 2022 census administrative map
administrative_geography.lower_level_status: Metadata identified; boundary geodatabase download requires login and has not been imported.

crop_data_follow_up.geographic_coverage: Eight rural provinces; Harare and Bulawayo not represented in the provincial crop tables.
caveats: These are second-round assessment estimates, not completed post-harvest survey results.
No zeros were imputed for Harare or Bulawayo.
2024/25 soybean baseline conflicts with the separate Post-Harvest Survey and remains unresolved.
Sorghum natural-region Table 10a has an apparent Region 4 production error; excluded.

readiness_effect.crop_area_production_yield: Improved to partial with 11 crop-group provincial datasets; not passed for all 17 enterprises or all 10 administrative units.
readiness_effect.dated_farmgate_prices: Still partial; GMB policy prices and ZMX exchange transactions are not automatically realized farmgate netbacks.
readiness_effect.input_and_operation_costs: Still partial or blocked; current farmer-paid prices and operation costs not complete.
readiness_effect.enterprise_budgets: Blocked; no validated complete regional budgets.
readiness_effect.calculator_mapping_and_tests: Blocked; no validated Zimbabwe region-enterprise regression cases.

source_conflicts: 2024/25 PHS soybean output: 57,750 MT in Tables 3.2/3.8 versus 7,750 MT printed in Table 3.7; 2025/26 CLAFA-2 uses 41,919 MT as the 2024/25 comparator.
2025/26 CLAFA-1 preliminary maize area was 1,898,528 ha; the later CLAFA-2 second-round assessment reports 1,916,150 ha and 2,346,256 MT.
Sorghum natural-region Table 10a reports 679,222 MT for Region 4 against 290,216 MT national total; not used.
safeguards: No existing active country profile or calculator formula was changed.
Only the separate first-level region lookup was updated.
No lower-level districts or wards were imported from an access-restricted boundary file.
No policy producer prices, wholesale/exchange prices or retail prices were relabelled as verified farmgate realizations.
No national crop totals were substituted for missing city-province crop data.
No merge, pull request or production deployment was performed.
next_step: Continue with the eight countries still missing first-level region lookup entries, then close Zimbabwe's producer-price, input-cost, enterprise-budget and functional-test gaps.
